video.title: I Did Something Insane. Here Are the Businesses I Found in It

summary: Chris Koerner explains buying a 231-acre cattle ranch (Triple 8 Ranch) about 57 miles from downtown Dallas for millions, negotiating almost $400k off the list price using Claude to critique the appraisal and a 2% commission rebate from his wife acting as agent, financed 85% by a farm credit lender at about 6.7%. He covers agricultural tax exemptions, floodplain pricing, aquifers and the seller relationship. He then lists monetisation ideas for land: grass-fed beef shares (about 40% net margin, no ranch needed), a grazing lease, shop rent, hunting leases, a Texas farm pond database, a ranch YouTube channel, tiny homes, Hipcamp/RV/Airbnb stays, rent-to-own highway land for portable storage, and heavy equipment flipping and rental. The key takeaway is that land can be monetised many ways and many of the ideas don't require owning land.

speakers.name: Chris Koerner
speakers.description: Host of The Koerner Office; bought a 231-acre ranch in North Texas

ideas.name: Grass-fed beef shares without owning a ranch
ideas.one_liner: Buy cattle from a rancher, book a slaughterhouse months ahead, and sell quarter/half/whole cows or packaged beef direct to consumers, locally or shipped via e-commerce.
ideas.business_model: Bulk beef sales (shares) and packaged e-commerce
ideas.customer: Consumers who want to know where their meat comes from and buy in bulk to save money
ideas.problem: Beef prices are at record highs and buyers distrust grocery store beef
ideas.offer: Quarter, half or whole cow shares, or shipped cuts, grass-fed or grain-finished

pricing.notes: About 40% net margin claimed. Book slaughter dates months in advance.

acquisition_channels.details: Not detailed; plan to ship nationwide via his e-commerce business; earlier backyard version sold to local buyers.

ideas.delivery: Rancher raises the cattle on a grazing lease; owner earmarks and brands animals, sends them to a slaughterhouse at optimal size, packages and ships via e-commerce/fulfilment.
unit_economics_claims: Quarter cow about 125 lb at about $12/lb = about $1,500; whole cow about $6,000

acquisition.how: Inbound content and paid ads can be agent-run; local buyers via opted-in lists. Cold SMS/DMs to consumers are not allowed in the UK.

delivery.how: Cattle sourcing, slaughter scheduling and cold-chain shipping are physical and need human coordination.

support.how: Agent support for order questions; quality complaints need humans.

uk_applicability.notes: Beef box and meat share businesses exist in the UK; needs FSA-approved abattoir and cutting plant, local authority food registration, labelling and traceability rules; chilled delivery is costly.

quotes.text: you don't need to own a ranch or any land to do it. You just go talk to a rancher
quotes.speaker: Chris Koerner

quotes.text: $6,000 to sell a whole cow. And your margin on that, your net margin is going to be about 40%
quotes.speaker: Chris Koerner

ideas.name: Cow-calf operation selling calves at auction
ideas.one_liner: Rancher keeps bulls and heifers on pasture and sells 500-600 lb calves at auction in batches of about 15.

acquisition_channels.details: Local livestock auctions in Sulphur Springs or Mineral Wells, Texas.

ideas.delivery: Cattle graze; rancher manages hay and grass and hauls calves to auction.
unit_economics_claims: About 85 cattle, 2 bulls; calves sell for about $1,400 each

uk_applicability.notes: Suckler herds exist in the UK with different subsidies, prices and land costs.

ideas.name: Grazing lease of ranch land
ideas.one_liner: Lease pasture to a rancher who keeps running cattle on it for a monthly fee, preserving agricultural tax exemption.
ideas.problem: Ranchers need grazing land; landowners need ag use for tax exemption

pricing.notes: Nominal monthly fee; amount not stated.

uk_applicability.notes: Grazing licences are common in the UK; agricultural property relief rules differ.

quotes.text: I'm just going to sign a grazing lease with him. So he'll pay me a nominal monthly fee
quotes.speaker: Chris Koerner

ideas.name: Hunting leases and shooting activities
ideas.one_liner: Charge for guided hog hunts, helicopter hunts, deer hunting, clay pigeon shooting or a rifle range on rural land.

pricing.notes: Chris is not bullish because of low profit and liability.

uk_applicability.notes: UK firearms licensing, deer seasons and much stricter rules; hog hunting not applicable.

quotes.text: Hunting leases actually aren't super profitable. Not very bullish on that, especially for the liability
quotes.speaker: Chris Koerner

ideas.name: Texas farm pond database
ideas.one_liner: Build a database of the roughly 800,000 Texas farm and ranch ponds from GIS and satellite imagery, monetised by selling leads to pond services or a private fishing marketplace.
ideas.business_model: Lead sales to pond management/dredging companies; marketplace commissions
ideas.customer: Pond management, dredging and digging companies; anglers; pond owners
ideas.problem: No public database of private ponds exists
ideas.offer: Pond data and leads; private fishing access marketplace
ideas.delivery: AI agents process GIS, mapping and Google Earth imagery to build the database.
unit_economics_claims: About 800,000 farm and ranch ponds in Texas

acquisition.how: Selling data to B2B pond service companies; cold email to companies is legal in the UK, but leads about sole-trader landowners raise UK GDPR issues.

delivery.how: Imagery processing and database updates are software.

uk_applicability.notes: UK has fewer ranch ponds but many farm ponds and lakes; Ordnance Survey/Environment Agency data exist; using owner data for marketing needs a UK GDPR lawful basis.

quotes.text: there are 800,000 farm and ranch ponds in the state of Texas alone. And there's no public database, but there should be
quotes.speaker: Chris Koerner

quotes.text: You could sell the leads to pond management companies, pond dredging companies, pond digging companies
quotes.speaker: Chris Koerner

ideas.name: Ranch YouTube channel
ideas.one_liner: Document ranch life on a separate YouTube channel using existing team and YouTube know-how to cover the land payment.
ideas.offer: Videos about clearing land, trees, cattle and equipment

acquisition_channels.details: New Triple 8 Ranch channel, leveraging learnings on hooks, thumbnails and retention.

ideas.delivery: Chris films; existing team edits and makes thumbnails.
unit_economics_claims: Expects a fraction of the main channel's size to cover the ranch payment within about a year

acquisition.how: YouTube algorithm; editing can be AI-assisted.

delivery.how: On-camera personality and real ranch work.

quotes.text: if the YouTube channel gets to be a fraction of the size that this one is, then it would at least cover the payment
quotes.speaker: Chris Koerner

ideas.name: Tiny house community on rural land
ideas.one_liner: Rent tiny homes on a few acres of rural land monthly.
ideas.delivery: Landlord manages tiny homes on 20 acres.
unit_economics_claims: 14 tiny homes at $1,450/month, about $17-18k/month on 20 acres

uk_applicability.notes: UK planning permission for residential tiny homes in the countryside is hard to get.

quotes.text: there's a tiny house community with 14 tiny homes that she charges 1450 a month. They're fully occupied
quotes.speaker: Chris Koerner

ideas.name: Farm stays, Hipcamp campsites, RV sites and a glass-floor bridge Airbnb
ideas.one_liner: Monetise rural land with campsites, RV spots and a unique Airbnb built over a river 58 miles from Dallas.
ideas.offer: Campsites, RV sites, unique stay over a river
ideas.delivery: Owner builds and maintains sites; needs electricity, solar, septic.

uk_applicability.notes: Glamping and Hipcamp work in the UK; planning rules and the 28/60-day permitted development camping rules apply.

quotes.text: I'm thinking about putting like a bridge Airbnb, an Airbnb that goes over the river with like a glass floor
quotes.speaker: Chris Koerner

ideas.name: Rent-to-own highway land for portable self-storage
ideas.one_liner: Lease cheap highway-frontage land with an option to buy, place portable storage units, prove the business, then buy the land.
ideas.delivery: Portable units delivered to leased land; buy land once proven.
unit_economics_claims: Never failed for his Canadian friend

uk_applicability.notes: UK planning permission needed for storage containers on land; change of use rules.

quotes.text: He finds raw land on highways. He rents to own it and he gets portable storage units and he builds storage facilities
quotes.speaker: Chris Koerner

ideas.name: Heavy equipment flipping at auctions
ideas.one_liner: Buy dozers, dump trucks and other equipment at auctions and resell without taking delivery.

pricing.notes: Purchase prices; resale margins not stated.

ideas.delivery: Buys at auction and resells without taking delivery.

acquisition.how: Listing and research can be automated.

uk_applicability.notes: Plant auctions exist in the UK.

quotes.text: I know a guy that just flips heavy equipment. He goes to auctions, he buys them and he sells them
quotes.speaker: Chris Koerner

ideas.name: Renting out equipment and land extras
ideas.one_liner: Rent skid steers, RVs and other equipment on Facebook Marketplace when you have space to store them; also rent the shop on the ranch.

uk_applicability.notes: Works in the UK; insurance needed.

quotes.text: I'm going to buy a skid steer RV. All of those things can be rented out on Facebook Marketplace
quotes.speaker: Chris Koerner

ideas.name: YouTube paid membership with business plans
ideas.one_liner: $5/month YouTube channel membership giving exclusive interviews and every 25+ page business plan from the episodes.
ideas.offer: Exclusive videos plus 15 business plans a month (sold separately at $19 each)
ideas.delivery: Business plans produced each episode; delivered via YouTube.
unit_economics_claims: 15 plans a month at $19 = about $300 value

quotes.text: All you got to do is pay five bucks a month. And you know what? YouTube takes 30% of that

tactics.name: Use Claude to pick apart a land appraisal
steps: Upload the seller's appraisal and screenshots of comparable sales to Claude
Have it flag mismatched comps (60-acre comps used for a 231-acre ranch; larger parcels are cheaper per acre)
Use it to draft negotiation replies
Get your own appraisal before closing

quote.text: Claude alone, my $20 and this is not an ad for Claude
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

tactics.name: Win a discount through the seller relationship
steps: Meet the seller in person and tour the property with him
Show you will keep the land rural (no neighbourhood or data centre)
Honour handshake commitments such as keeping a tenant at below-market rent

quote.text: just by nature of who you are as a person means you can get a discount below fair market value
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

tactics.name: Rebate agent commission as negotiating leverage
steps: Get a real estate licence (about $1,000 and tens of hours of study)
Represent yourself or have a family member do it
Give back part of the commission at closing to bring the price down

quote.text: we essentially gave back 2% of her 3% commission at closing
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

tactics.name: Beef shares supply chain
steps: Agree with a rancher to buy and earmark/brand specific cattle
Let them grow to the optimal size instead of selling at 500-600 lb
Book slaughterhouse dates months in advance
Package and sell quarters/halves/wholes or ship cuts via e-commerce

quote.text: Be sure you get a date months in advance because they get very busy
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

tactics.name: Rent-to-own land to de-risk a land business
steps: Find unloved land on Zillow (floodplain, highway frontage, long on market)
Lease it with an option to buy
Put portable/removable assets on it (storage units)
Buy the land once the business is proven; walk away and resell assets if not

quote.text: he rents it until he's proved the model. Once he has a successful business, he buys it
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

tactics.name: Own equipment instead of hiring contractors
steps: Buy used dozers and dump trucks at auctions or on Facebook Marketplace
Hire operators at $20-50/hour instead of $200-500/hour contractors
Resell the equipment when finished

tactics.name: Use farm credit lenders for land
steps: Use an ag or farm and ranch bank that only lends on large tracts
Expect about 15% down, 20-year amortisation, 5-year ARM

quote.text: I think it was really important to go through a farm credit lender because this is what they know
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

tools_mentioned.name: Claude
tools_mentioned.purpose: Appraisal analysis, comps, negotiation drafts, pond database research

warnings.warning: A lapse in agricultural tax exemption lets the county claw back back taxes, potentially hundreds of thousands of dollars.

quote.text: if there's a lapse in your a exemption status, then the county will claw back back taxes
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

warnings.warning: Appraisals using comps of much smaller parcels overstate per-acre value.
Floodplain land is worth about a third and you can't build permanent structures on it.
Hunting leases carry liability and aren't very profitable.
North Texas land prices went parabolic 2020-2024 and have been dropping; timing is uncertain.

quote.text: either it's going to keep dropping and I bought at a bad time or I bought the dip
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

warnings.warning: Septic near rivers is regulated, complicating riverside rentals.
Don't make enemies with neighbours or tenants when you buy rural property; relationships are the deal pipeline.

quote.text: Relationships are like the whole deal pipeline out in the country
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

lessons.lesson: Buy land in the path of growth as an asymmetric bet: worst case you enjoy it, best case it appreciates.

quote.text: I just see this as an asymmetric bet
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

lessons.lesson: Land near rail trails turned state parks has historically outperformed; look for public infrastructure catalysts.
You don't need to be vertically integrated: big beef brands buy from farmers rather than owning ranches.

quote.text: Butcher Box and like Snake River Farms, all the big boys, they don't have their own ranch
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

lessons.lesson: Commodity markets are not winner-take-all; many sellers can succeed.
Learnings compound like money: skills from one YouTube channel transfer to a new niche channel.

quote.text: Your learnings compound just like money does
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

lessons.lesson: Prove a land-based business on leased land with an option to buy before committing capital.
Missing public databases (like farm ponds) are data business opportunities now that GIS and AI agents exist.

quote.text: All the tools are there. this GIS, mapping, imagery, Google Earth, AI agents
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

lessons.lesson: A cheap AI subscription can save large sums in negotiations by checking professional work like appraisals.
Hard, physical chores build work ethic in kids.

evidence_quality.rationale: First-hand purchase details with specific numbers; the business ideas are mostly untested brainstorms and second-hand anecdotes.
evidence_quality.promotional_conflict: Sponsor read for Bizee; promotes YouTube membership and tkoyes.com.
